items.title: 14.5.2 Jangal katne ka fiza par asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.5.2, printed page 311.

blocks.text: Deforestation insanon ka jangalon ko jaan boojh kar saaf ya patla karna hai aur aalmi climate ke sab se bare masail mein se hai: jangal CO2 jaisi greenhouse gases jazb karte aur hamare liye hawa saaf karte hain. Deforestation ke mahol par bure asrat ki wasee range hai, jin mein hayatiyati tanawwo ka nuqsan, climate change, mitti ki kharabi aur pani ke cycle ka bigarna shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Jangal katna hawa ke mayar par kaise asar dal sakta hai (exercise Q.2b)?
blocks.explanation: Darakht photosynthesis se carbon dioxide hatate aur apne patton par dhool aur doosre zarraat rokte hain; unhen katna yeh safai khatam karta hai, lakri mein jama carbon chhorta hai (khaas kar jab woh jalai jaye), mitti ko hawa ke kataao ke samne karta hai jo dhool urata hai, aur yun hawa ko zyada gandi aur greenhouse gases se bharpoor chhorta hai.

items: Deforestation (jangal saaf ya patla karna) CO2 ka sink aur hawa saaf karne wala hatata hai: hayatiyati tanawwo ka nuqsan, climate change, mitti ki kharabi, pani ke cycle ka bigarna.
